verdict.rationale: Alloy's marketing describes Fraud Signal, a machine learning model that produces fraud-risk signals, plus agentic automation for KYC/AML checks. Together these are a thin form of AI-derived insight from customer data inside the product. The evidence is homepage-level only and never shows AI-generated insights or suggestions being surfaced to the user. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insight or suggestion surfaces, a description of what the ML/agentic outputs look like to users, explanation of recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ditch static rules for Fraud Signal, our machine learning model that adapts as threats evolve
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
Monitor your portfolio continuously with real-time risk signals
